jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - PMO (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).


As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.

You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.

Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
  • Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
  • Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
  • A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
  • Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
  • Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)
  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional fluency in English; German language skills and certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PSM) are a plus

We know that you may not currently meet all of these requirements. But if you bring the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm for the role, we can achieve great things together.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.


Tech stack & tools:
  • Linear (backlog, sprints)
  • Confluence
  • Google Workspace 
  • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
  • Figma 
  • QGIS and comparable viewers
  • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
  • very high resolution optical imagery
  • synthetic aperture radar
  • 3D surface models 
  • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
  • agentic tools for a variety of work.


Your challenge

As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

  • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

  • Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

  • Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

  • Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

  • Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.


Your profile

  • Professional ISR, GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

  • Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

  • Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

  • German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

  • German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

  • You take ownership and proactively push work forward. 

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

  • Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

  • You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.

  • Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus.

jobs.title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
jobs.description:
About Tandem

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures.


We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

  • Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics.

  • Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped.

  • Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there.

  • Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved.

  • Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.


The benefits


Passion for languages: 

We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us.


Take a deep dive: 

As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style.


Teams who train together, stay together: 

We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead.


It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (All gender)
jobs.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution.


Your mission

You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Translate Needs: Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team.

  • Push the Backlog: Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones.

  • Drive Execution: Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly.

  • Document Capabilities: Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver.

  • Evaluate & Accept Work: Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms.

  • Technical Literacy: You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers.

  • Systems Thinking: A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers.


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration.

  • Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context.

  • Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors.

We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

jobs.description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we´re looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you`ll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

    • beneficial ownership checks,

    • PEP and sanctions screening,

    • high-risk customer reviews,

    • escalation of sensitive cases within SLA.

  • Review and approve complex or high-risk KYB cases.

  • Ensure continuity of compliance during the transition from the current BaaS model to Pennylane Financial Services’ own operating model.

  • Maintain strong auditability of KYB decisions, including rejection rationales, escalation trails and supporting documentation.

Team build-up & performance management

  • Define the target team structure, roles, responsibilities and escalation paths.

    • SLAs,

    • productivity metrics,

    • quality metrics,

    • backlog monitoring,

    • capacity planning.

  • Prepare the team to scale toward high-volume onboarding at go-live and beyond.

  • Build a strong team culture based on rigor, accountability, customer protection and continuous learning.

Process design, standardization & scalability

  • Translate regulatory policies into clear operational procedures, SOPs, decision trees and analyst playbooks.

  • Standardize KYB processes to ensure consistency, scalability and a smooth onboarding experience.

  • Identify bottlenecks in workflows and propose operational improvements.

  • Balance compliance rigor with operational efficiency, without compromising Pennylane Financial Services’ risk appetite.

  • Define how KYB processes should evolve during the migration from Swan’s operational model to Pennylane’s own LoD1 setup.

Tooling, automation & Product collaboration

  • Contribute to the implementation and optimization of KYB tooling and back-office workflows.

  • Work closely with Product and Tech teams to design efficient analyst interfaces and operational workflows.

  • Help test KYB tooling before go-live from an operational perspective, not only a technical one.

  • Identify opportunities for automation on repetitive tasks such as document verification, data collection, alert triage or case pre-analysis.

  • Ensure that automation improves efficiency while preserving quality, traceability and risk control.

Quality assurance, controls & reporting

  • Implement a QA framework for KYB operations:

    • random sampling,

    • peer reviews,

    • calibration sessions,

    • error tracking,

    • remediation plans.

  • Monitor operational and risk indicators to detect process weaknesses or compliance issues.

  • Produce regular reporting on KYB performance, risk trends, backlog, SLA adherence and quality.

  • Support Compliance / LoD2 during audits, controls testing and regulatory reviews by providing evidence and operational insights.

  • Provide operational input on new features, customer journeys and onboarding requirements.

  • Help Product and Tech teams understand KYB constraints and translate them into pragmatic product decisions.

  • Collaborate with other LoD1 teams, especially Transaction Monitoring and Fraud & Risk, to ensure a coherent customer risk lifecycle.

  • Build the first version of the KYB performance dashboard and operating cadence.

    • runbooks,

    • decision trees,

    • QA process,

    • incident escalation paths,

    • capacity model.

  • Ensure the KYB organization is ready to support ~10,000 onboardings per month while maintaining compliance quality and customer experience.

Profile & must-have experience

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in KYB/KYC, compliance operations, risk operations or financial services operations.

  • Experience in a regulated environment such as a fintech, bank, payment institution, EMI or BaaS / embedded finance provider.

  • Proven experience managing or coordinating operational teams in a high-volume environment.

  • Strong exposure to AML/CTF requirements and business customer onboarding.

  • Experience translating policies into operational processes, SOPs and analyst guidance.

  • Hands-on experience with KYB tooling, back-office tools or workflow automation.

  • Experience working with Product / Tech teams on tooling or process improvements.

  • Bonus: experience with ACPR expectations, licence applications, audits, BaaS migrations or credit-related onboarding.

Technical & operational skills

  • Strong understanding of KYB/KYC workflows for business customers:

    • legal entity verification,

    • UBO identification,

    • document review,

    • risk classification,

    • PEP / sanctions screening,

  • Good knowledge of French and European AML/CTF frameworks, including ACPR, TRACFIN and FATF expectations.

Dein Projektinhalte:

Fachliche Konzeption und Produktentwicklung

The Purpose:

As a Product Manager in PPRO’s Local Payments Domain, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the payment experiences for our customers and partners, ensuring seamless, compliant, and efficient access to local payment methods. You will drive product discovery and delivery, working at the intersection of Engineering, Marketing, Risk, and Commercial teams to enable seamless adoption of local payment methods to some of the world’s leading fintechs, PSPs, and merchants.

Product Managers at PPRO have the passion and abilities for ensuring that we focus our time and energy on building the right things for our customers. You will inform the strategy, communicate with all relevant stakeholders and lead effective product discoveries with your team. Our mission is to make local payment methods as ubiquitous and accessible as credit cards. You will own and develop a portfolio of Local Payments integrations, engaging with schemes, defining a strong value proposition, and validating and setting success metrics.

In this impactful and highly visible role, you will own key business opportunities and product initiatives related to the portfolio, orchestrating flows, fine tuning the user experience, and co-creating new features together with the schemes and our customers. Your work will directly impact PPRO’s ability to scale globally by increasing adoption, improving success rates, and driving the commercial and technical integration of high-value local payment products.

  • Work hands-on with data - analyze key business opportunities and success metrics related to payment acceptance rates, scheme performance, and financial flow efficiency to drive meaningful outcomes.

  • Be a thought leader in local payments – stay ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and best practices to keep PPRO at the forefront of effective, efficient, and accessible payments across the world.


What Success Looks Like

  • Improved adoption and financial performance of the local payments portfolio through optimization and strategic feature releases.

  • Higher payment success rates and fewer manual interventions for payment flows.

  • Seamless integration and expansion of new local payment methods and features into the core PPRO platform, replacing legacy integration methods.

  • Clear, data-driven insights into payment performance (acceptance rates, authorization rates, scheme metrics), with real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

  • Positive feedback from customers and partners on the functionality, reliability, and value derived from the local payment methods.

📋 Tes missions au quotidien

Accueil et cadrage du cabinet

  • Animer la réunion de lancement : objectifs, périmètre, jalons, rôles

  • Identifier les référents et le sponsor côté cabinet

  • Clarifier les contraintes calendaires et poser les bases d'une collaboration structurée dès le premier échange

Parcours de formation

  • Remettre le kit de formation et inscrire les équipes aux sessions collectives Pennylane

  • Suivre la participation, relancer les équipes et t'assurer que tout le monde monte à bord

Mise en route et migration

  • Définir les prérequis et établir un planning daté et réaliste

  • Organiser des créneaux de déblocage courts et réguliers

  • Centraliser les retours : traiter ce qui est de ton ressort, transmettre les sujets techniques aux bonnes équipes (Migration, Support, Produit)

Suivi et reporting

  • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord : avancement, adoption, incidents, risques

  • Produire des comptes rendus clairs et actionnables après chaque point de suivi

  • Préparer le dossier de passage structuré pour l'équipe en charge du suivi long terme

Conduite du changement

  • Outiller le sponsor et le référent interne pour relayer les bonnes informations à leurs équipes

  • Recueillir les retours terrain et identifier les points de friction

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des supports : FAQ, guides pratiques, modèles de documents

🙋 Le profil qu'on recherche

  • Expérience en cabinet comptable avec au moins 3 périodes fiscales complètes : tu connais les cycles de l'intérieur : tenue, révision, TVA, clôture

  • Une expérience dans l'accompagnement de clients ou la formation est un vrai atout

  • À l'aise avec les outils collaboratifs : Google Workspace, tableurs partagés, visioconférence, messagerie asynchrone

  • Crédible métier : les cabinets te parlent d'égal à égal, tu comprends leurs enjeux sans qu'ils aient besoin de tout expliquer

  • Sens du service et fiabilité : tu fais ce que tu dis, dans les délais que tu annonces

  • Goût pour l'amélioration continue : chaque onboarding est une occasion d'apprendre et de faire mieux la prochaine fois

⚙️ Le process de recrutement

On a voulu un process lisible et sans étapes inutiles :

  1. Un premier échange avec un Business Recruiter — pour se découvrir et poser les bases

  2. Un entretien avec un Team Leader Project Manager — pour rentrer dans le fond du poste

  3. Un cas pratique avec un Project Manager — pour voir comment tu travailles concrètement

jobs.description:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.


Job Overview

Our Structure team builds the software foundation for consistent, scalable index development at Solactive. We provide APIs, libraries, configuration patterns, testing frameworks, and reusable components for index construction workflows, supporting a great UX for ideation, production, and maintenance of new indices with clients. In this senior role, you will shape the technical architecture of a business-critical service that accelerates index development and improves quality across the index lifecycle. If you thrive on leading complex initiatives and shaping engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you.


Your Tasks

  • Lead the technical direction and architectural evolution of the domain, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions for internal and external users of the index development service.
  • Lead complex initiatives end-to-end: clarify ambiguous requirements, shape solution approaches, and drive implementation across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, including code and design reviews, coaching, and a strong focus on simplicity, quality, and maintainability.
  • Partner with product, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify core problems, challenge assumptions, and deliver solutions aligned with the platform vision.
  • Drive system design across distributed services, APIs, integrations, data models, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness.
  • Improve engineering effectiveness by refining processes, reducing friction, strengthening ownership, and enabling better trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk.
  • Mentor engineers and support their growth in technical depth, ownership, and end-to-end delivery. 


Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on software engineering background (10+ years) with deep expertise in common programming languages. We use Java, Python, and Typescript.
  • Strong system design skills, including service decomposition, API design, integration patterns, data modeling, scalability, reliability, and operational concerns in cloud-native environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deploying, operating, and troubleshooting cloud-native applications in containerized environments.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous, business-heavy problem spaces: identify real requirements and root problems, structure chaos, and translate needs into quality technical solutions.
  • Proven track record of simplifying complex systems and delivering maintainable end-to-end solutions with high business impact.
  • Strong experience with modern engineering practices: code reviews, design reviews, CI/CD, testing strategy, observability, incident response, and production ownership.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders without formal authority.
  • Product mindset and delivery orientation: balances technical quality with business value and drives initiatives to completion.
  • Experience with React and TypeScript frontend development is a plus. 


Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive.
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience the cutting-edge world of FinTech at Solactive.
  • Modern Culture: Thrive in our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture.
  • Responsibility & Connections: Take responsibility from day one and build valuable relationships both inside and outside the company.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 days of annual vacation, plus additional time off for Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve.
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package.
  • Special Benefits: Benefit from a job ticket, Corporate Benefits program, modern office space with an ergonomic setup, employee lounge, and complimentary beverages and fruits.
  • Community & Networking: Participate in our various networking events, tech talks, and business talks.
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offerings.
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, including a hybrid work model, all within a diverse and dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Engineer (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

As the Tech Lead for the backend, frontend, mobile and fullstack software engineers, you will own and shape the architecture of the underlying services as well as their technical roadmap for the services that together create Treeline, our application that helps predict and prevent wildfires, storm events and generally power and train outages due to vegetation, weather and climate.

Technically, that means rendering and querying large volumes of geospatial data efficiently in both browser, mobile and backend, handling complex and custom business logic, writing the services that make that fast, and building integrations for the growing number of third-party consumers of our services.

We are a team of five engineers today, actively growing, embedded in a cross-functional group of product managers, UX/UI designers, data, DevOps, ML, and geospatial engineering experts. You will not be the only person responsible for any system you touch and we’re a friendly bunch.


Your challenge

  • Lead, support and coordinate the team that builds Treeline while still being around 60% hands-on
  • Architect, build and extend features end-to-end that handle large volumes of geospatial data, with attention to UX and design
  • Design and build well-designed, performant API endpoints and backend services used by partners and customers
  • Coordinate tightly with other functions in cross-functional temporary squads
  • Shape and influence how your team works and how we work together in a greater context

Stack:
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript
  • Backend: NestJS, TypeORM
  • Mobile: React Native
  • Database: PostgreSQL (including geospatial workloads, PostGIS and OGC)
  • Infrastructure & CI/CD: AWS, GitLab


Your profile

Must have

  • First experience as a techlead, knowing that the team and product takes priority over your own hands-on work, always
  • Strong Backend experience with NestJS, Express, or Node.js
  • High level of TypeScript, React in production (Vue or Preact also fine — we care that you know a component model well, not which one)
  • Familiarity with mobile development, especially React Native
  • You've worked in a codebase with CI/CD and code review, and can find your way around a system you didn't build
  • You've used AI-assisted coding in your actual day-to-day, not just tried it once
Nice to have
  • Spec-driven or test-driven development, agentic or otherwise

Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.
  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.
  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Entwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) - Remote, 4-Tage-Woche
jobs.description:
Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.
  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.
  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.
  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.
  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.
  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.
  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.

Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.
  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.
  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.
  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.
  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.
  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.

Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)
  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)
  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen
  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen
  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)

Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.
  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.
  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.
  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.
  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.
  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.

Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.
  • Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung.
  • Remote first, Team always: Trotz Remote bleibt das Teamgefühl. Wir feiern Releases, grillen im Sommer und stoßen auf tolle Ideen an. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor.
  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.
  • Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl.
  • Perks, die was bringen: Kita-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Leipziger Jobticket oder sportliche Angebote für deinen Ausgleich – vom Homegym bis zum Fitnessstudio für Kopf und Körper.

Dein Weg zu uns

Keine Lust auf lange Anschreiben? Kein Problem! Erzähl uns einfach kurz, warum du Teil vom Händlerbund werden möchtest und warum wir gut zu dir passen. Nutze dazu die Möglichkeit dich online über unser Bewerbungsformular zu bewerben.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
Product Owner (all genders)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung.

In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte.

Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert.


Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten

Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln

  • Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen.
  • Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen.
  • Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung.
Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten
  • Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick.
  • Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen.
  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden.
Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management
  • Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab.
  • Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
  • Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern.
Beraten & Wissen vermitteln
  • Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter digitaler Lösungen und Technologien.
  • Du begleitest bei Bedarf Ausschreibungen, Angebotsbewertungen und Beschaffungsprozesse.
  • Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf und unterstützt Anwender durch Workshops, Schulungen und geeignete Materialien.


Was du mitbringst

  • mehrjährige Erfahrung in digitalen Projekten, IT-Projekten, Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbaren Rollen mit eigener Verantwortung.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Nutzer, Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge.
  • Die Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu strukturieren und Entscheidungen herbeizuführen.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mindestens C1).
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft (50% Anwesenheit am Standort Würzburg). 


Warum du bei uns richtig bist

Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die nicht nur visionär klingen, sondern die Bauwelt tatsächlich smarter und zukunftsfähig machen – und das Ganze in Projekten und mit Kund:innen, die garantiert nicht langweilig werden. Dabei bist du von Anfang bis Ende mitten im Geschehen und hast ein Team an deiner Seite, das fachlich top ist, menschlich der Knaller und jeden Partybus das Fürchten lehrt. Wir glauben an Flexibilität statt Stechuhr, an Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und an stabile Verhältnisse. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
TL;DR: This is not a classic sales role. We have a full pipeline of some of the largest companies in the world, and we're looking for the sharpest enterprise sellers to own those accounts end-to-end, not just the signature. From first conversation to multi-year partnership.

Why Conduct

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change, every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

What you'll own

You own everything between Conduct and the customer, and the commercial outcome with it:

  • Run the full sales cycle: first meeting, multi-stakeholder qualification, technical deep dives, pilots, steering committees, procurement, and close.

  • Build pipeline too. Most of our pipeline is partnership-led today and we do less outbound than we'd like, simply because we don't yet have the capacity, so the new logos you open add straight to your number.

  • Stay after signature. Work with our Deployment Strategists to drive adoption, get onsite when it counts, and grow one deal into a multi-year partnership. We don't hand accounts off; you own them end-to-end and pull in deployment support where you need it.

  • Build the engine: the sales motions, playbooks, and tooling that let us serve more customers without scaling headcount one-for-one, and feed what you hear from customers straight back into product.

Who we hire

This is an entrepreneurial role: there is no finished playbook, and you'll build as much as you run. You'll fit right in if your former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest operators they've ever worked with.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • 3+ years in enterprise sales, with a real track record of closing complex, high-ACV deals

  • You've sold technical products and are curious enough to go deep on a hard space. No SAP or ERP background needed, but within a few weeks you can hold your own in a conversation with an enterprise IT team.

  • You own accounts beyond the close, growing them into bigger relationships rather than just landing logos.

  • Strong communication, storytelling, and executive presence. You can run a room.

jobs.title: VP Revenue
jobs.description:
About Gladia

Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer.

Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR, across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.

Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).

Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group.

We're guided by four values:

  • Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

You'd get the independence and pace of a startup, backed by the balance sheet, infrastructure and distribution reach of a major group. This role reports directly to Gladia's COO.

We're scaling from an early product-led traction phase into a structured, predictable growth engine — and we're hiring the leader who will own that transition end to end.

The mission

Own and scale Gladia's entire revenue engine from single-digit millions to tens of millions in ARR. That means more than closing deals. You'll own the full commercial system — sales, partnerships, customer success, and forward-deployed engineering — and you'll build the team, the process and the operating rhythm that make that growth repeatable rather than heroic. You'll inherit traction and a strong product; your job is to turn it into a machine. With OVH Groupe behind us, you're not racing to the next round — you're building for durable, predictable growth, with the resources to do it properly.

This is a turnaround-and-scale role. You diagnose what's holding the current team back, level up, hire what's missing, and personally carry the most strategic deals while you're doing it.

The team you'll inherit

Distributed across Paris & NYC.

  • 1 Head of Sales

  • 4 Account Executives

  • 2 SDRs

  • 2 Forward-Deployed Engineers

  • 1 Customer Success

  • 1 RevOps (reporting to Operations)

What you'll own

  • Revenue strategy & GTM. Define a repeatable go-to-market across both motions that matter for an API business: developer / product-led adoption and enterprise sales. Own segmentation, pricing (in partnership with Finance), and a forecast leadership can be trusted.

  • Enterprise sales. Lead from the front on our largest, most complex deals — multi-stakeholder, technical buying committees, long cycles. Build the playbook (MEDDICC or equivalent) and coach the team on it rather than just preaching it.

  • Partnerships & ecosystem. Design and stand up the strategy partnership: cloud marketplaces, integrators, CPaaS and platform partners in the voice/AI ecosystem. You define what this channel even is for Gladia — its scope, its first partners, and the model for turning it into real revenue. And you get a head start few revenue leaders are ever handed: distribution through OVHcloud's platform and customer base — yours to build and exploit as you see fit.

  • Customer success & expansion. Own net revenue retention and expansion.

  • Forward-deployed engineering. Turn FDE into a core lever of the sales strategy — embedded in deal strategy and closing — and build out a complete catalog of service offerings around it.

  • Process audit. Audit every commercial process end to end and instrument the funnel that makes the whole engine measurable and predictable.

  • Leading the team. Managing & scaling a high-ownership international revenue org distributed across Paris and New York.

Who you are

  • 10+ years in B2B revenue leadership, with a track record of scaling a company through a comparable ARR band

  • You've personally carried and closed complex enterprise deals — and you're credible with technical buyers (CTOs, engineering and product leaders), not just procurement.

  • At ease across the full deal spectrum — from self-serve and SMB transactions to six- and seven-figure enterprise contracts .

  • Experience selling into both private and public sectors, comfortable with the longer cycles, procurement and compliance the latter demands.

  • You've owned more than sales: you've run or worked hand-in-glove with customer success and partnerships, and you grasp the role solutions / forward-deployed engineering plays in landing technical accounts. This role spans the full revenue org, so a pure sales background isn't enough.

  • You've recruited and led teams, ideally internationally (in French & US territories).

  • You're equally a 0 → 1 builder: you've created a function, a channel or a process from a blank page — not only optimized what already worked.

  • Sharp and highly organized — you bring operational rigor: clean pipeline, reliable forecasts, and processes the team can actually run on.

Bonus points

  • You've monetized a usage-based / consumption model.

  • You've built a partnerships / distribution channel from scratch at an earlier-stage company.

  • You've worked alongside (or stood up) a solutions / forward-deployed engineering function.

What Gladia offers

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Analytics House
Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Embedded AI
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you!

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

  • 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings

  • 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

  • You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

  • You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

  • You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

  • You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

  • You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

  • You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

  • You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

  • You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

  • You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding.

  • You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working.

  • You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement.

Within 3 months:

  • You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics.

  • You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability.

  • You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools.

  • You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations.

Within 6 months:

  • You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap.

  • You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems.

  • You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.

Who are we looking for?

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python.

  • Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks.

  • Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model.

  • Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI.

  • Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance.

  • Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts.

  • Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows.

  • Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections.

  • Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints.

  • Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview covering problem framing, data, modeling, evaluation, deployment and monitoring (75 min)

  • A past project interview to discuss your experience and technical decisions (60 min)

  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (30 min)

  • Track record avéré dans la structuration d'un partner program (tiering, contracts, incentives)

  • Fort business acumen : tu raisonnes en termes de ROI, pipeline et revenus générés

  • Leadership et gestion d'équipe : tu as déjà managé des profils BD/Partnership et sais faire grandir une équipe

  • Excellentes capacités de négociation et de relationship-building avec des interlocuteurs techniques ET business

  • Fluent French + professional English (minimum)

  • Expérience du lancement à l'international (Allemagne et/ou Espagne, un plus)

  • Maîtrise d'outils comme Salesforce, Crossbeam, ou équivalent

  • À l'aise avec l'IA générative dans son quotidien pro (Dust, Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator…)

  • Tu es à l'aise dans l'ambiguïté et tu sais prioriser sans qu'on te dise quoi faire

  • Tu es data-driven sans être paralysé par le manque de données parfaites

  • Tu as un sens aigu de l'ownership et tu t'engages sur des résultats, pas sur des activités

  • Tu sais influencer sans autorité hiérarchique — la transversalité, c'est ton terrain de jeu

- Amélioration continue : Remonter les tendances ou récurrences de problématiques avec son team lead, proposer des axes d’amélioration des process ou du produit, et participer à la mise en place de formations et solutions correctives ou préventives

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres ton équipe et passes du temps avec chaque membre pour te familiariser avec ce nouvel environnement,

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements,

- Tu apprends à maîtriser notre organisation de développement produit et à communiquer efficacement avec les développeurs (la majeure partie de notre équipe tech est anglophone, il faut donc être à l'aise en anglais),
